newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cofap cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cofap cut to hold.

text.p: -- Dresdner Kleinwort Benson analyst Carl Weaver on Monday cut his rating for Brazilian auto parts maket Cofap to hold from buy.

-- "With no reason to change current estimates and the share price now at the high end of our price targets, we believe that the share price, in the best-case scenario, will perform in line with the local index," he wrote in an analysis.
-- "There is potential for an upside surprise ... but given its tremendous rally since (second-half of 1996) and current valuations, we downgrade Cofap to hold."
Cofap last traded on February 13, when it closed at 15 reais.
